data: Amazon's total net sales rose from $574,785 million in fiscal 2023 (year ended December 31, 2023) to $716,924 million in fiscal 2025 (year ended December 31, 2025), according to the Consolidated Statements of Operations in its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K. That is an increase of $142,139 million, or about 24.7% over the two years. The intervening fiscal 2024 figure was $637,959 million. Most of the growth came from net service sales, which climbed from $318,898 million to $420,658 million, about 31.9%. Net product sales grew from $255,887 million to $296,266 million, about 15.8%.
